summary: Dedicated cluster suspension hours were billed and then duplicated after automatic resume
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports hourly charges for their Dedicated cluster during a period when the cluster was in 'suspended' state for compliance remediation. After the cluster automatically resumed, the invoice contains both the suspended-hour line items and the resumed-hour line items for the same time windows, resulting in duplicated hours on the finalized provisional invoice. Impact: Customer's provisional balance increased by ~$4,600 for the cycle; risk of auto-pay failure and contract churn.
Environment: Dedicated capacity (cluster id: dc-92fj), prod, us-west-2. Billing cycle: 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28.
Observed behavior: Two invoice lines for overlapping hours: one labeled 'suspended-hours (reserve hold)' and another 'dedicated-active-hours' covering the same 12-hour window during which the scheduler reported the cluster 'suspended'.
Expected behavior: Suspended hours should be recorded as zero billable hours or moved to a reserve/credit line, not billed twice. Automatic resume should only bill subsequent active hours, not recreate billed suspended hours.
Steps to reproduce:
1) Create a Dedicated cluster and trigger compliance suspension (simulate scheduling hold).
2) Allow system to auto-resume after remediation window.
3) Run hourly billing reconciliation for cluster hours.
4) Inspect provisional invoice lines for overlapping periods.
Relevant logs and evidence:
- Cost dashboard snapshot: link in related_confluence_pages
- Billing run job id: br-2026-02-28-18
- Cluster scheduler event: scheduler log snippet (2026-02-16T04:00Z SUSPEND -> 2026-02-16T16:30Z RESUME)
- Invoice extract: attached CSV referenced in comment thread.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Induce suspension on dedicated cluster dc-92fj in us-west-2.
2) Wait for automatic resume at remediation end time.
3) Run billing reconciliation job br-2026-02-28-18 and compare generated line items against scheduler events.
4) Validate that suspended window is not billed twice.

comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Support (Lena Ortiz): Customer Nimbus Health submitted provisional invoice showing duplicated hours. Customer has paused their autopay until resolved. Customer requests credit and explanation.

2026-03-10 11:05 - Billing Eng (Marco Alvarez): Acknowledged, flagging to Dedicated runtime team. Initial hypothesis: billing run used merged event stream and double-counted intervals due to late-arriving resume event.

2026-03-11 08:47 - SRE (Priya Nair): Reproduced locally with synthetic cluster. Found race between scheduler event ingestion and hourly-aggregator window application. If resume event arrives after aggregator marks suspended-hour as final, resume processing triggers second record without dedupe.
2026-03-11 14:30 - Support (Evan Brooks): Notified customer of investigation and provisional credit hold. Escalated priority. Linking to INT-1024 for aggregator dedupe patch.

2026-03-12 10:02 - Billing Eng (Marco Alvarez): Patch candidate PR opened at https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/214 with idempotency fix; requires canary in staging then backfill for affected invoice runs.
investigation_notes:
- Query run on billing DB: SELECT * FROM hourly_aggregates WHERE cluster_id='dc-92fj' AND window_start BETWEEN '2026-02-16' AND '2026-02-17' shows two records with different source tags (suspend vs active).
- Found 2 relevant code paths: hourly-aggregator marks 'finalized' when it processes first state; late event path writes a separate 'correction' line but correction wasn't deduplicated due to missing canonical event id.
- Affected billing run br-2026-02-28-18 did not include dedupe token due to scheduler event ingestion backlog during routine maintenance in us-west-2.
- Estimated impact across customers: ~8-10 dedicated customers with similar patterns during the same maintenance window.
- Related issue: SUP-751913 referenced for similar dedupe bug from last quarter.
- Risk: auto-pay customers may be charged incorrectly on finalized invoice if not corrected before finalization.
resolution_notes:
Interim workaround: Issued provisional credit equal to duplicated hours for Nimbus Health (credit id CR-2026-03-11-NH-01). Blocked automated autopay for the upcoming charge until invoice correction.
Fix applied: Merged idempotency patch (PR #214) to billing service; canary run completed in staging; rollout to prod scheduled 2026-03-13 02:00 UTC. Backfill: billing-backfill-job br-backfill-2026-03-13 will recompute aggregates for br-2026-02-* runs and emit adjustment credits for affected customers.
Follow-ups: (1) Add event canonicalization token to scheduler events to prevent duplicate aggregate creation. (2) Add alert to detect overlapping billed windows where suspended + active sum > window length. (3) Postmortem to be created and linked to confluence page.
Customer communication: Notified Nimbus Health of provisional credit and ETA for final adjustment. Will follow up after backfill completes.
resolution: Provisional credit applied and idempotency patch merged; backfill job scheduled.
final_root_cause: Race condition: late-arriving scheduler resume events created correction lines that were not deduplicated by the hourly-aggregator due to missing canonical event id and lack of overlap detection in billing reconciliation.
next_steps: Run billing backfill for affected billing runs (br-backfill-2026-03-13)
Roll out aggregator idempotency patch to prod
Create postmortem and update runbook to include overlap alerts
